name: Scenes-opt
purpose: Settings of the scene flow: what happens inside a scene and at the boundary between two scenes. It is not an audio-target list; audio modulation lives in React-to-opt.json.
ownershipRule: React-to owns the single layer (audio -> parameter). Scenes-opt owns the scene as a block (timing, display, playback) and the boundary between two scenes (out of scene N, in of scene N+1).
panelRule: The scene panel opens from the scene field in the Scenes strip (not from React-to) and always shows the settings of the SELECTED scene. Switching scene switches the content of the same panel; nothing is duplicated per scene.
boundaryRule: A boundary has two independent slots: Out (end of scene N) and In (start of scene N+1). Set one, the other, or both. Fade out on scene 1 + fade in on scene 2 are two slots on the same boundary; a fade in only on scene 2 is a single In slot. The strip shows them at the correct side of the boundary.
depthRule: Three levels: lv1 = scope (scene / boundary / project), lv2 = branch, lv3 = the setting. Grouping is the 'group' field of each lv3 entry.

lv1.label: Scene
lv1.desc: The selected scene as a block of the timeline. Editing here never moves the user into React-to.

lv2.label: Timing
lv2.desc: Where the scene sits in the timeline and how it ends.

lv3.label: Start
lv3.desc: Start time of the scene, derived from the previous scene and its transitions.

lv3.label: End
lv3.desc: End time of the scene, derived from its duration.

lv3.label: Duration
lv3.desc: Length of the scene. Changing it moves every following scene.

lv3.label: Snap
lv3.desc: Grid the duration and the playhead snap to.

lv2.label: Playback
lv2.desc: How the scene runs when the playhead crosses it.

lv3.label: Speed
lv3.desc: Playback speed of this scene (1 = real time).

lv3.label: Hold last frame
lv3.desc: Keeps the last rendered frame visible after the scene ends.

lv3.label: Loops to start
lv3.desc: Loops back to the scene start instead of the global loop.

lv2.label: Grid & export
lv2.desc: The grid is the drawing aid: it is hidden in animation and in export unless the export asks for it. These values only affect the exported/rendered scene.

lv3.label: Show grid in export
lv3.desc: Renders the grid lines in the exported video. Off by default: the grid is a drawing aid.

lv3.label: Grid color
lv3.desc: Line colour used only when Show grid in export is on.

lv3.label: Line width
lv3.desc: Line width of the exported grid.

lv3.label: Line opacity
lv3.desc: Line opacity of the exported grid.

lv2.label: Content
lv2.desc: What belongs to this scene. Read-only here: the layer stack is edited in the Layers panel.

lv3.label: Layers
lv3.desc: Layers of this scene, in draw order. Each row opens its layer and its React-to modulations.

lv3.label: Modulations
lv3.desc: Number of audio modulations attached to the layers of this scene, with a jump to the React-to panel of the selected layer.

lv1.label: Boundary
lv1.desc: The seam between scene N and scene N+1. It appears in the strip between the two scene fields.

lv3.label: Type
lv3.desc: Exit animation of the outgoing scene. None leaves the scene until its last frame.

lv3.label: Duration
lv3.desc: Length of the exit. Never longer than the outgoing scene.

lv3.label: Easing
lv3.desc: Curve of the exit.

lv3.label: Type
lv3.desc: Enter animation of the incoming scene.

lv3.label: Duration
lv3.desc: Length of the enter. Never longer than the incoming scene.

lv3.label: Easing
lv3.desc: Curve of the enter.

lv2.label: Pairing
lv2.desc: How the two slots behave together.

lv3.label: Match out and in
lv3.desc: On: one transition drawn across the seam (out and in share type and duration). Off: two independent slots, e.g. fade out only, or fade in only.

lv3.label: Overlap
lv3.desc: How much the out and the in overlap at the seam. 0 = sequential.

lv1.label: Project
lv1.desc: Defaults used by every scene and by the export.

lv2.label: Defaults
lv2.desc: Values applied to new scenes and boundaries.

lv3.label: Scene duration
lv3.desc: Duration given to a new scene.

lv3.label: Out duration
lv3.desc: Exit duration given to a new boundary.

lv3.label: In duration
lv3.desc: Enter duration given to a new boundary.

lv3.label: Easing
lv3.desc: Curve given to a new boundary.

lv2.label: Export
lv2.desc: Output of the whole scene flow.

lv3.label: Frame rate
lv3.desc: Frame rate of the exported video.

lv3.label: Width
lv3.desc: Pixel width of the export.

lv3.label: Height
lv3.desc: Pixel height of the export.

lv3.label: Format
lv3.desc: Container/codec of the export.

lv3.label: Loop the export
lv3.desc: Repeats the whole scene flow in the output file.
